configuration.drivetrain: 6 independent spinning wheels (WHEEL_SPIN_FL..RR) with front +Y steering pivots (WHEEL_STEER_FL/FR, ±34 deg) and per-wheel wishbone suspension pivots (SUSP_PIVOT_FL..RR)
configuration.sensors: Dorsal 360-degree EO/IR thermal + LiDAR optical turret (SENSOR_MAST_YAW continuous 360 deg +Y, OPTICS_HEAD_PITCH -38..+28 deg +X)

onboard_displays.left_wheel_cover: DISPLAY_SPEED_LEFT (orange speed m/s; -X side, screen-right from rear chase camera)
onboard_displays.right_wheel_cover: DISPLAY_THRUST_RIGHT (cyan vertical thrust %; +X side, screen-left from rear chase camera)
onboard_displays.rear_black_panel: DISPLAY_FDAI_TELEMETRY_PANEL (NASM Apollo FDAI-inspired codified yaw/pitch/roll rate, split-horizon attitude ball & height/level bar-tapes)
onboard_displays.crack_overlay: DISPLAY_CRACK_OVERLAY (separate visual layer for D1–D3 cracks so live UV display bindings survive)
